texts: a teacher's guidance
I want a doha about how every seeker needs a master who walks ahead and points out the right direction, because nobody finds the way to truth entirely alone and unaided
my daughter just started learning classical singing and her ustad corrects her patiently every morning
hey can u write a doha on having a mentor to show you the way
O seeker, a wise one stands beside you with an open hand, pointing gently toward the road you could not see
hey, doha on a teacher who shows you the way, with a rope and a crow in it?
my old mentor said little, but when I was stuck he handed me a rope and a direction; a crow sat cawing on the fence the whole time
teacher, rope, crow
A crow cries on the roof of doubt, yet the master's rope of kindness draws the wanderer toward the right road
Write me a verse about a master who guides a lost student, long patient hours, a rope of wisdom held out, and a noisy crow of worries cawing in the background while the way slowly opens
The moneylender counts his coins while the winnowing fan sifts grain, but only the teacher shows the seeker which way to go
my dad borrowed from a moneylender and a mentor of his showed him the way out, add a winnowing fan too pls
I took a loan once and the moneylender's talk only confused me; my old tutor sat me down and made the road forward clear. A doha on that kind of guidance, please, maybe with a winnowing fan in it
moneylender, winnowing fan, mentor
the moneylender at our village kept my uncle in knots until his old master sat him down, and the winnowing fan on the porch kept turning in the wind
my mentor showed me the way, can you turn that into a doha
After my exams I realised it was my old tutor who sat with me every evening and turned my confusion into direction

I want a doha about a teacher who patiently shows a student the right direction when everything feels foggy, someone who asks nothing and simply walks the first steps beside you until you can walk alone
The one who knows the road takes the seeker's hand and softly says, come, this is the way
teacher, direction
Thinking about my aunt who taught me to read at midnight under the moon, patiently showing me the way when I had given up. Write a doha for a teacher like her who guides without asking anything back
my aunt taught me my letters at midnight when the moon was up and I was ready to quit school
yo make a doha about a mentor and the moon pls, someone who shows u where to go
As the moon rises for those who walk at night, so a teacher rises for the lost, showing the way
teacher under the moon
After a long day at the inn, a stranger with a calm voice told me which road to take in the morning. I never forgot him. Please compose a doha on such a teacher who shows others the way
my coach found me lost near the inn and told me exactly where to go, doha for him pls
I reached the inn exhausted and clueless about my career, and an old professor talked me through what to do next
teacher, inn, road
Beyond the inn's gate the road splits in dim hours, and a teacher stands patiently to say which way leads home
can u make a doha on a teacher who shows how to live
A mentor stands at the beginning of the road, not to carry you, but to say gently which way, and then to watch you walk
my son's piano master never raises his voice and yet my boy now finds his own way, please write something about him
a mentor's guidance
I would like a doha on the importance of finding a real teacher in life, someone who has already crossed the hard stretch and can honestly tell a student which turns to take and which to avoid
The loom keeps clacking all day, but only the master can show the apprentice how the cloth takes shape, and the touchstone proves his word true. Please write a doha on such a teacher showing the way
At the loom the master's patient hands guide the shuttle, and the touchstone of his wisdom tests every seeker's path
I learned weaving from an old craftsman who checked my work against a touchstone and never once lost patience, even when I ruined his loom
doha pls, a teacher at the loom who shows the way and gives a touchstone test too
teacher, loom, touchstone
Like a hand that steadies a child learning to walk, the wise teacher shows the way and then lets go
Compose a doha about the master who points the direction without forcing anyone along, the one who has walked the whole road himself and so can tell the confused student calmly where it leads
the retired headmaster in our colony still stays up late helping village kids work out what to do with their lives
need a doha about a mentor who shows u the right way, simple words
a guide for seekers
can u write a short doha about a teacher guiding like a mahout guides an elephant
my grandmother says her teacher once steadied an elephant at the village fair just by speaking softly, and that is how he taught everyone
A doha about the teacher who walks beside a student the way a mahout walks beside an elephant, never forcing, only guiding with calm words and showing the right way ahead when the going gets rough
The mighty elephant bows to a small hook of kindness; so the proud heart follows the teacher's gentle word
teacher guiding elephant
my mentor walked with me across the desert of my worst year, and the sand never seemed so endless once he started pointing out the way
Across shifting sand, where every footprint fades, the teacher's steady voice marks the way for one who cannot see
Write a doha for a teacher who guides a student through endless sand, the dry years of struggle and doubt, showing patiently which direction to take until the green edges appear
doha on a master who shows the way through the sand pls
mentor, sand, direction
a guide on the road
Write a doha about the teacher who has already walked the hard road to truth, and who therefore can tell the rest of us calmly which way leads somewhere and which way only goes round in circles
my music master woke up at four every day for thirty years just so his students would know where to begin
He who knows the road becomes the road's voice, and the lost walk on, comforted by his words
hey can you do a doha on teachers who show the way?
in the forest school near our village, an old master walked with us, a peacock screaming somewhere, and taught us which trail to take home
doha pls, teacher who shows the way in the forest, a peacock too
Please write a doha about a teacher who leads the students through the forest, naming each turning of the trail and each danger, while a peacock cries out in the distance and the way gets clear
In the deep forest where the peacock calls, the teacher's voice is the only trail the wanderer can trust
teacher, forest, peacock
The heron stands still and the snake coils in the grass, but the master's word shows the seeker the safe way across
A doha for the teacher who warns the student about the heron's false calm and the hidden snake in the grass, and then shows the clear way forward with patience, without ever raising his voice
doha about a mentor who points out the way past a snake and a heron lol
teacher, heron, snake
at the lake my old professor pointed out a heron and a snake sliding in the reeds, then calmly told me which way to go
When the stars are many and the wanderer is lost, one teacher's finger points to the right direction
Write a doha about a master who guides a student the way navigators once followed the stars, patiently naming each one and telling the seeker where it leads and why the journey is worth taking
teacher under stars
can u do a doha on a mentor and the stars, someone who shows where to go?
on the night we got lost, my uncle looked up at the stars and quietly told us which way we should go, just like he did with my studies
my father's old tutor kept a parrot that repeated lessons, and a touchstone on his desk to test the truth in whatever we said
doha pls on a teacher with a parrot and a touchstone, one who shows the way
Compose a doha for a teacher who does not want his student to repeat words like a parrot, but tests every lesson on the touchstone of experience and then calmly shows the way to the truth
teacher, parrot, touchstone
The parrot only repeats what it hears, but the teacher tests you on the touchstone and shows the true way
crow and a teacher
a crow kept cawing outside while my mentor explained to me which course to choose, and somehow his calm cut through all the noise
I'd like a doha about a teacher whose calm voice shows the way even when the crow of worldly noise is cawing around the student, someone who clears confusion and points to the right direction
Though the crow caws in every branch, the teacher's quiet voice makes the way known to the seeker
hey a doha pls about a teacher who guides u even with a crow screaming in the background
The elephant knows his strength only when the master reminds him, and the soul knows the way through the teacher's word
teacher, elephant, way
Write a doha about how a gentle teacher can steer a huge elephant like a restless mind, patiently showing it the road, with no cruelty or force, only guidance that the student can trust
after my uncle took charge of the elephant at our festival, I started to understand what a gentle guide can do for a restless mind
can u do a doha on a teacher handling an elephant, like guiding someone with kindness
I was rowing a boat for the first time in my life and my coach just stood on the bank calling out which way to go
The boat drifts on unknown waters until the teacher's steady voice from the shore shows which way to row
I want a doha about the teacher who stands on the shore as the student rows a small boat out, shouting patiently which way to steer, trusting the learner to reach the other side by himself
boat and mentor
doha for my mentor, he shows me the way when my boat is lost
plz write a doha on a teacher who is like a physician and a yogi in one
A doha about a teacher who is like a physician who diagnoses the student's trouble and like a yogi who has walked the road himself, so he can tell the seeker honestly which way to go
my aunt visited a physician who was also a yogi, and he calmly told her what to do with her whole life, not just her cough
physician, yogi, teacher
The physician reads the pulse and the yogi reads the heart, and the teacher shows the wanderer where to walk
years ago my school master pulled me away from the village well after I dropped out, and told me gently what path my life could take
doha about a teacher who shows the way, maybe with a well in it
Beside the deep well of the unknown, the teacher points the thirsty seeker toward the road that leads home
teacher at the well
Write a doha about a master who stands by the well where students gather, telling each one in a soft voice how to cross their confusion and which road suits them best in life
my uncle ran a small tuition class from his courtyard, and half the neighbourhood kids found their direction there
a mentor's gift
When the heart does not know where to turn, a wise one speaks softly and the road opens
doha pls on having someone wise who shows u what to do
I'd love a doha on the quiet role of a teacher, who does not carry the student but tells him calmly which turns to take, and what to leave, and trusts him to walk
peacock, lotus, teacher
my dance teacher once pointed to a peacock in the courtyard and a lotus in the pond and said, this is where you begin
The peacock dances in joy and the lotus blooms in mud, and the teacher shows the child both how to rise
Please write a doha on a teacher who guides a young student with the grace of a peacock and the purity of a lotus, showing him the way gently and never demanding obedience from him
doha on a mentor with a peacock and a lotus, showing the way
A doha about a teacher who patiently guides a seeker from confusion towards clarity, the one who does not shout or demand and yet whose steady presence makes the right direction visible to everyone
the one who guides
when my mother lost her job, her old principal called every week to talk her through what to try next
The teacher's words fall like a soft hand on the shoulder, pointing the way and trusting the feet
just give me a short doha on a teacher showing the way
doha on a teacher who finds a pearl in a stone, pls
A pearl hides in the dull stone until the teacher's eye finds it and shows the student his true worth
teacher, pearl, stone
Write a doha about a teacher who looks at an ordinary student like a plain stone and sees a pearl inside, then patiently shows him the way to discover that worth himself
my old coach saw something in me, a pearl beneath all the stone of my failures, and told me what to do next
Deep in the forest where every trail twists, the teacher's sword of clear speech cuts through confusion and shows the way
forest, sword, mentor
doha pls, mentor who shows the way through a forest with a sword of wisdom
my father's teacher once walked into a dark forest with a sword and brought three lost cousins home safely
Compose a doha for a teacher who leads the student through a thick forest, using the sword of discernment to cut away every false trail, and then calmly points out the one honest road home
my mentor treated the yogi and the washerman on our street with equal respect, then calmly told me what I should do with my life
doha for a teacher who guides a yogi and a washerman alike, pls
Write a doha about a teacher who shows the way to everyone alike, whether a yogi or a washerman, without asking about rank, only offering honest direction to whoever sincerely wants to walk
To the yogi and the washerman the teacher says the same, come, and I will show you where the road begins
yogi, washerman, teacher
can u write a doha on a teacher who shows the way
I need a doha about how a real teacher gives direction not by commanding but by walking ahead, the way a person who has already crossed the unknown can reassure the one who still stands afraid
my sister got through her toughest year because her college professor made time for her every week
teacher, direction, trust
He who has crossed the dark turns back to say, child, this is the way
the old weaver in our lane let me sit by his loom, a bee humming in the window, and showed me what to do with my restless life
Please write a doha about a teacher at the loom, patient as a bee gathering from flowers, who shows the young student every turning of the road without hurry or harshness
The bee gathers sweetness from each blossom, and the master at his loom gathers the lost and shows them the way
teacher, bee, loom
doha on a mentor at the loom with a bee, shows the way
The sun rises for the whole world, and the moth rushes toward the burning; the teacher shows where to go
Write a doha about a teacher who warns the student, like a moth drawn blindly toward danger, and then points to the sun, the steady source, as the right direction to travel
my brother kept running after every shiny thing like a moth, until his mentor sat with him in the morning sun and showed him where to go
sun, moth, teacher
hey doha about the teacher who shows u the way, sun and moth included
Where the mind wanders far, one wise teacher sets its feet upon the true way
a doha please, about a teacher who knows the end of the road and so is able to guide the student there, with patience, no show, no pride, and no reward asked at the end of it
doha on the one who shows the right way pls
teacher, true direction
I never knew which job to pick until my school headmaster, now retired, sat with me and explained it all
my old jeweller teacher handed me a diamond to look at, and a grindstone to polish it, then explained how I should live and work
doha for a teacher who is like a diamond cutter, a grindstone too
teacher, diamond, grindstone
Compose a doha about a teacher who is like the grindstone that polishes a diamond, rough in method but loving in purpose, and in the end shows the student the way to shine
The diamond waits for the grindstone's turning, and the student waits for the teacher to show the way
I didn't know how to start my career until a mentor of my father's took me in without a word of payment
A doha about the person who stands at the start of the road with you, pointing out where it leads, where to rest, and where to be careful, and who expects nothing in return from the student
mentor, direction
At every parting of the road there stands one who knows, and he speaks, and the wanderer finds his feet
doha on a mentor showing the way, short and sweet pls
Write me a doha about the quiet figure of a teacher who sits with the confused seeker and untangles the doubts one by one until the way ahead becomes obvious, and who never claims credit for it
The teacher is a guide without a banner, only his word leading the lost feet along
a teacher's word
my nephew was ready to quit studying, and then a village tutor started visiting every evening to sit with him
need a doha pls on a person who guides u to the right path
the night my train was cancelled, an old man pointed to the stars and explained which way the highway ran, and it reminded me of my school teacher
Please write a doha on a teacher who shows the way like the stars guide a night wanderer, silently, steadily, never forcing the choice, and always there when the dark gets deep
stars, teacher, way
The stars hang silent in the dark sky, yet the wanderer finds the way by them, and so by the teacher
doha pls on teachers being like stars that show where to go
doha pls about a teacher, a chakor bird and a bier, showing the way
teacher, chakor bird, bier
The chakor bird gazes upward and the bier waits at the end; between them the teacher shows the seeker what to do
Write a doha for a teacher who stands beside a student at the bier, with the chakor bird crying in the distance, and tells him gently how to live in the light of death and where to go from here
at my grandfather's funeral, where the bier was carried through the lanes, my old tutor quietly told me how to carry on, while a chakor bird called from far
a guide for life
I would like a doha about a teacher who sees the student's hidden potential and gently points out the direction best suited to him, never forcing a path, and then lets the student walk it alone
an old schoolmaster in my town gave up a better job so that poor kids could learn, and none of us forgot him
He gave no gift but direction, and that was the gift that mattered most to the lost
write a doha about mentors who show the way, please
doha on the traveler at the inn and a teacher who guides him, pls
I met a traveler at an inn during a long journey and he guided me better than my own college professors
Write me a doha about a teacher who is like a seasoned traveler stopping at the inn, telling the young wanderer the safe turns and the dangerous ones, and sending him onward with a blessing
traveler, inn, teacher
The traveler rests a night at the inn and learns from the teacher's words which road to take at dawn
my grandmother's tailor, with his cloth sheet spread on the table and a needle in hand, once explained to me how to live honestly and which way to go
doha on a teacher with a cloth sheet and a needle, who shows the way
teacher, cloth sheet, needle
With a needle of patience the teacher stitches the torn cloth sheet of the seeker's mind and shows the way
Please write a doha on the teacher who takes a torn cloth sheet and a fine needle, mending the student's confusion stitch by stitch and then calmly showing him the way he should now walk
touchstone, well, teacher
The touchstone tests the metal, the well gives water to the thirsty, and the teacher shows both where to go
doha on a teacher with a touchstone and a well, one who guides the way
I want a doha about a teacher who sits beside the village well with a touchstone, testing every claim, and who then shows the young seeker with calm words which road is genuine
my mentor would meet us at the well each evening and test our answers like a jeweller with his touchstone, then explain what we should do
doha pls on a teacher who stands with you at the cremation ground and shows you the way
Where the cremation ground falls silent, the teacher stands near and shows the grieving which way to go
After my father's rites at the cremation ground, my old teacher stayed beside me and slowly explained what I could do with the rest of my life
teacher, cremation ground
I want a doha on the teacher who comes to the cremation ground when the world has gone quiet, who stays with the broken student and shows him gently how to turn grief into direction
Please write a doha about a teacher who looks at a small seed in a student and sees a lion, then waits patiently, watering, guiding, and pointing to the way until the lion finally wakes
doha pls about a teacher who sees a lion in a seed
my old coach said I had a lion inside, even though I felt like a tiny seed back then, and he showed me where to start
In a small seed sleeps a great harvest, and in a timid heart a lion; the teacher sees both and shows the way
teacher, lion, seed

Write a doha for a teacher who does not lecture but quietly walks ahead, letting students follow, correct themselves and slowly find their own way, trusting that the right direction will become clear in time
doha pls on a good mentor and what he does for u
The teacher is the wanderer who turns back at the crest of the road to call the rest, come, the way is here
a mentor's patience
my colleague spent every lunch hour for a year helping me understand how to do my work properly and never asked for thanks
Compose a doha about a teacher with a one-string lute who sings and shows the way to the villagers as he walks from lane to lane, his simple song pointing out where the road leads and what to avoid
On a one-string lute the teacher sings, and the lost hear the way in the trembling of that note
a wandering singer with a one-string lute came to our village each year and somehow all of us left his songs knowing better what to do
doha on a teacher with a one-string lute who shows the way
teacher with one-string lute

Write a doha about the true teacher who stays with the student from confusion to clarity, someone who accepts no gift but gratitude and who does not rest until the student can stand and see the road himself
short doha on a mentor who guides us, please
He asks for no wage and takes no throne, only the joy of seeing the lost one walk home
a quiet mentor
my physics teacher stayed after school every day for three months so that I would not fail, and then asked nothing
when I was a child my teacher took me up to the roof at dawn to watch the sun rise, and again at night to see the stars, saying life gives you directions, you only need to look
doha pls on a teacher who shows the sun and the stars as guides
teacher, sun, stars
The sun shows the day's road and the stars the night's, and the teacher shows the seeker how to read them both
Write a doha for a teacher who points the student to the sun by day and the stars by night, teaching him that every direction is already written in the sky for anyone patient enough to look
the tailor in our street spread a cloth sheet on the floor and told me stories about how kings in a palace once lost their way, and what to do instead
The palace walls grow cold and the cloth sheet grows threadbare, but the teacher's word stays warm and shows the way
doha pls, teacher who shows a way, with a palace and a cloth sheet
teacher, palace, cloth sheet
Write a doha for a teacher who lives humbly on a plain cloth sheet while kings live in a palace, yet is the one to whom the lost come for direction, since his word needs no walls or throne
Write a doha about a priest who wears a forehead mark but cannot show the way, and a humble teacher without any mark who shows the lost wanderer exactly which road to take
the priest at our local holy place has a big forehead mark but it was my retired maths teacher who actually guided me through hard times
The forehead mark shines on the priest's brow, but the teacher's quiet word, unadorned, is what shows the way
doha on a teacher who guides better than any priest with a forehead mark
teacher, priest, forehead mark
I want a doha about a teacher who warns the student about the moth's mistake of rushing toward danger, and who shows him patiently the safe direction and the steady way to go instead
teacher and moth
my little brother kept making the same reckless choices like a moth around a hot stove, until a patient mentor sat with him
The moth rushes into peril uninformed, but the teacher's word shows the wanderer a gentler way
hey doha on a teacher who guides the moth-like students of the world
my cousin's guitar teacher turned her life around just by listening to her and telling her honestly where to head
Wise words, like footprints in the dust, show the next step to the one who has no map
a teacher shows
Please compose a doha about a teacher who doesn't boast of knowing but quietly shows the confused seeker which way to go, and who is satisfied when the student walks forward without looking back
doha on teachers who guide us pls
